0.original: Korutt is eager to step into the relative safety of the cave.

26.original: While invisible, use dream powder on Gogg family dwarves.

48.original: 'Twas a near thing in the end, but what matters is that we pulled through. Well fought, my friend.

49.original: Right, follow me please! I will take you to the Duergar's Tewel, where the purest sulphur in the land may be found!

51.original: Who the hells are you!? We don't take kindly to outsiders, so bugger off afore we kick you out!

52.original: Who the hells are you!? If you're not one of us, you must be one of the Tholls! Bugger off afore we kick you out!

53.original: Ahhh! Intruder! Send word to Chief Glagg!

54.original: ...Hmmm? Well, such a strange-looking Talos you are.

55.original: ...Hmmm? Are you a Gogg? You don't look like a Gogg. That must make you...a Talos. Yes, a Talos.

56.original: If the terrain and─<cough>─stench are any indication, we are at the tewel.

58.original: The Goggs! With their ugly, unkempt beards!

59.original: If they realize we're here, they'll come after us. Best to take them down first!

60.original: Be not so hasty, Korutt. The animosity between your two clans notwithstanding, I would not resort to violence unless necessary.

61.original: I will use an enchantment to render you invisible. It will not fool sin eaters, but it will suffice to hide you from the eyes of men.

62.original: While you are thus concealed, do you think you could find us the earthseed?

63.original: Aye, I'll dig up the choicest stuff there is!

64.original: We would be much obliged. Without further ado, then...

65.original: Hah, I can see straight through me! Right, a-digging we will go!

66.original: Let us not be idle either.

67.original: Though Korutt cannot be seen, he may still be heard. I would aid him by removing some few Goggs from the field. To that end...

68.original: Dream powder. As you may recall, we used it for the rescue mission at Laxan Loft.

70.original: We used it in Eulmore too.

72.original: Truly? It seems our alchemists got a little carried away with the latest batch...

73.original: But if it has been useful in our endeavors, then I have no cause to complain.

74.original: Now then, I shall make you invisible as well, that you might steal close to the dwarves and give them a dose of dream powder.

75.original: Even should it fail to put them to sleep outright, it should render them drowsy enough to seek their beds.

76.original: Say the word, and I will cast the enchantment.

78.original: Should the enchantment fade before you finish tending to all the dwarves, return to me and I will cast it anew.

79.original: Need another dose of invisibility, do you? Very well.

80.original: Who the hells are you!? We don't take kindly to outsiders, so bugger off afore we kick you out!

81.original: Who the hells are you!? If you're not one of us, you must be one of the Tholls! Bugger off afore we kick you out!

82.original: Unnngh, can barely keep my eyes open... Time to call it a day...

83.original: Ahhh! Intruder! Send word to Chief Glagg!

84.original: <yawn> So drowsy... Not safe to work when drowsy... Better get some rest...

85.original: ...Hmmm? Well, such a strange-looking Talos you are.

86.original: ...Hmmm? Are you a Gogg? You don't look like a Gogg. That must make you...a Talos. Yes, a Talos.

87.original: <yawn> All work and no ale makes...something a something. And I'm spent...

88.original: All the dwarves have taken their leave. Good work, my friend.

89.original: We have done all that we can. Let us await Korutt's return.

91.original: This is the purest stuff there is. Think it's enough, or shall I go and dig up some more?

92.original: I daresay it will suffice for our purposes. You have our gratitude, Korutt.

93.original: Let us carry this back to...to...

95.original: ...Worry not, I shall be fine. Long as I have been away from the Crystarium, a little weakness is to be expected.

96.original: I may have also overexerted myself in the moment. Ah, to have this rare opportunity yet be unable to enjoy it to the full...

98.original: Uwaaah! Th-That's Glagg, chief of the Goggs!

99.original: You! You're one of the Tholls!

100.original: I see, I see... Word was our miners were comin' back drowsy, one after the next. I immediately suspected foul play...

101.original: And what should I find here but Tholl scum skulkin' about! It's a spineless act befittin' your limp beards!

102.original: What!? I won't stand for that insult!

103.original: Our beards are soft and luscious and smell like freshly tapped ale! Gogg beards are dry and crusty and smell like a knocker's arse!

104.original: Impudent whelp! Better a hobgoblin's nose hairs than the feeble, floppy things you Tholls have hangin' from your faces!

106.original: Like oil and water... This is not like to end of its own accord.

107.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, do you perchance have some dream powder left?

109.original: Enough to put an end to this.

111.original: But this was beginning to get interesting...

112.original: Then let us put it to use and be on our way. Though something tells me we've not seen the last of their bickering...

113.original: You are a kind and considerate soul, my friend, but I believe we would be forgiven for needing to hurry. Let us put an end to this and be on our way.

114.original: Worry not, my friend. Something tells me you'll have ample opportunity later to witness their bickering. For now, however, we should be on our way.

117.original: Forgive me, Korutt, but we need you to be calm as well.

118.original: I-I'm sorry... It's just, when it comes to the Goggs, I can't help but see red...

119.original: You needn't apologize, my friend. You are here on our account, and we have naught but gratitude for you.

120.original: Now that we have what we came for, however, it is time to take our leave. The Talos awaits its heart!
